A1.justification: Both PDFs describe VISTA and the same planning-based summarization framework. Their main text, tables, figures, equations, and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original model benchmarks, ablations, controlled-generation experiments, dataset quality checks, and human and LMM-as-Judge evaluations.

after.justification: v4 retains these original results and adds modality-combination experiments, nonvisual planning evaluations, a NoQUD ablation, and manual plan validation.

M1.justification: The GPT-o1 silver-plan construction and independently trained Plan Generation and Summary Generation modules remain unchanged. The new text/audio experiments reuse this pipeline; NoQUD is an evaluated ablation.

E1.justification: The English VISTA dataset and scientific-presentation summarization task are retained. Table 4 adds joint-input scenarios involving video plus transcript, audio plus transcript, and all three modalities, extending input-condition coverage within the same dataset.

E2.justification: v4 adds NoQUD, which generates all plan questions at once, to the planning comparison in Table 5, formerly Table 4. The main benchmark and human-evaluation comparator sets remain unchanged. The earlier All-Context analysis is separately retained.

E3.justification: New protocols include seven modality configurations across three learning regimes with modality-dependent module freezing, paired planning/nonplanning evaluations for three nonvisual models, and a 100-sample binary plan review using two validity criteria. Existing splits, model versions, training settings, metrics, and the 50-instance human summary evaluation are retained.

E4.justification: v4 adds analyses of modality interaction, the contribution of sentencewise QUD planning, planning beyond visual models, and silver-plan validity. These address distinct questions absent from v1. Earlier video-context, text-context, controllability, and error analyses remain under Appendices H–K.

E5.justification: Both versions specify seed 2025 and use paired t-tests at p < 0.05 and Fleiss' kappa. The added evaluations extend these existing statistical reporting practices; no revised repeated-run or uncertainty-estimation procedure is documented.

E6.justification: Matched original benchmark and appendix scores are retained, while Tables 4 and 6 add substantial modality-combination and nonvisual-planning results. Table 5 adds NoQUD with R2 13.66 versus 13.74 for the retained QUD method. Appendix G reports plan-review kappa 0.853, and Section 7 supplies the previously omitted human conciseness kappa of 0.792.

T1.justification: The dataset formalization, conditional distributions P(s|v) and P(s|v,p), and QUD-based planning assumptions are retained. No new mathematical derivation, theorem, or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The dataset, benchmarking, and human-performance-gap contributions remain. The introduction broadens the planning contribution from improvements over video LMMs to improvements over SOTA models more generally, consistent with the added text/audio experiments.

C2.justification: v4 adds explanations linking transcript-fusion difficulties to noisy, lengthy ASR inputs and presents planning as a discourse scaffold beyond vision. It revises model/modality applicability limitations and adds a qualification about not identifying optimal planning. Explicit English-generalizability and baseline-pretraining/prompt-selection caveats are removed; judge-related contamination concerns remain.

D1.justification: The front-page access link changes from a GitHub repository to a project page. Appendix M generalizes PG/SG prompt templates to audio and text inputs, and the modality study documents module freezing. Existing model identifiers and detailed training hyperparameters remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The scientific-summarization discussion replaces HAESum/SAPGraph examples with RST-LoRA/RSTformer and adds references including Liu et al. (2022, 2025). The overall research positioning remains similar. Numerous other bibliography changes are publication updates to already cited works.

P1.justification: The main narrative order is retained, with localized rewrites of the abstract, introduction, results, conclusion, and limitations. The former Additional Analyses appendix is divided into separately titled sections, alongside terminology and affiliation edits.

P2.justification: v4 adds full-width modality and nonvisual-planning result tables, adds an Open-source column and reorders rows in Table 3, and expands the planning-ablation table. It also redraws the venue pie chart, removes the second illustrative dataset example, and relocates several appendix displays.

improvement.justification: v4 strengthens the planning analysis by directly testing modality interaction, nonvisual applicability, and the NoQUD alternative, addressing gaps acknowledged in v1. Manual plan review adds useful evidence. The net gain is limited: the central dataset and benchmark remain unchanged, useful language and contamination qualifications disappear, and plan validation reports agreement without a valid-plan rate.
